verses.text: \s1 Thupatna
Kote sungah thu piang te mitampi in a ban a ban in at zo a, tua thu tangkona te sia ka up bel uh a hihi,
A kipatcil pan in mitmu tetti te le Pathian kamal naseam te i hong son bang in a ki at a hihi;
A masabel pan in thu theampo a cialcing in he ka hikom, na tungah a ban a ban in hong at leng pha tu hi, ci ngaisun khi hi, a thupibel Theofilas awng,

Nangma hong hil sa thu te a kip a kho thei natu in hong at khi hi.   
\s1 Zacharias le Elizabeth
Judah kumpipa Herod hun lai in, Zacharias a kici thiampi khat om a, ama sia Abijah i thiampi pawl sungah kihel hi: a zi min sia Elizabeth hi a, Aaron suan a hihi.
Amate ni sia Pathian mai ah mi thutang te hi uh a, thupiak te le biakna ngeina te paubang ngawl in a zui te a hi uh hi.
Amate in ta a nei bua uh hi, banghangziam cile Elizabeth sia ciing hi, taciang amate a ni ma in a kum uh zong ham zo hi.
Zecharias sia ama pawl te taw a nasep hun cing a Pathian mai ah thiampi nasep a sep laitak in,
Thiampi te ngeina bang in aisan in ki teal uh a, Zecharias sia Topa biakinn sung tum a ciang in ngimnamtui hal tu a hihi.

Ngimnamtui a hal laitak in mihonpi theampo a puasang ah thungen khawm uh hi.   
\s1 Tuiphumpa John Sua natu Sonkholna
Topa vantungmi khat a kungah hong kilang a, ngimnamtui hal na mun biaktau ziatsang ah ding hi.
Zechariah in ama a mu ciang in, patau a, a tungah launa theng hi.
Ahihang vantungmi in, Zechariah: lau heak in, Pathian in na thungetna hong za zo hi, taciang na zi Elizabeth in tapa hing tu a, a min sia John, phuak tu ni hi, ci hi.
Lungdamna le thinnopna nei tu ni hi; a sua ciang in mi tampi te zong lungdam tu uh hi.
Banghangziam cile ama sia Topa mai ah mi thupi hi tu hi, sapittui ahizong, zu ahizong, dawn ngawl tu hi; a nu ngil sung pan ma in Tha Thiangtho taw kidim tu hi.
Israel mi tampi te zong amate Pathian Topa kungah heakkiksak tu hi.

Elijah i thaa le vangletna taw Topa mai ah pai tu a, pa te le ta te i thinsung te ahizong, thu ni ngawl te mi thuman te i ciimna ah ahizong; Topa atu in mihing te kinging kholsak le ki thoaikholsak tu in heakkiksak tu hi.   
\s1 Zechariah Pau Thei Ngawl
Zechariah in vantungmi kungah, nong son bang in piang takpi tu hi, ci bangbang in he tu khi ziam? banghangziam cile keima sia pasal huai ka hihi, taciang ka zi zong huai mama zo hi, ci hi.
Tasiaciang vantungmi in, keima sia Pathian mai ah a ding Gabriel ka hihi; nangma paupui tu le lungdamna thu son tu in hong sawl hi.
Taciang, en in, hi thu te a pian ni dong pau thei ngawl tu ni hi, banghangziam cile amate hun ciang a tangtung tu ka thu na up ngawl hang a hihi, ci in zo hi.
Mipi te in Zechariah ngak uh a, biakinn sungah ngei mama om ahikom in, lamdangsa uh hi.
Biakinn sung pan a pusua ciang in amate tungah bangma son thei ngawl hi: taciang biakinn sungah mangmu hi, ci amate in he uh hi: banghangziam cile a khut taw lak a, pau thei tuan ngawl hi.
Thiampi nasep ni te a khuangkhim po ciang in Zechariah sia a inn ah cia hi.
Tuazawkciang in a zi Elizabeth naupai a, tha nga sung bu hi,

Tua ahikom Elizabeth in, Topa in keima atu in hi thu hong vawtsak hi, mihing te sungah zawnsakna ka thuak nate hong laksak tu in Ama in hong ve zo hi, ci hi.   
\s1 Jesus Suatu Sonkhol
Tha luk a cin ciang in, Pathian in vantungmi Gabriel sia Galilee ngam Nazareth khua ah a om,
Ngaknu thiangtho khat, David suan Joseph taw nupa tu in zuthawl piaksa, Mary kungah paisak hi.
Vantungmi a kungah hongpai a, na tungah thupha om tahen, nangma sia a thupi mama maipha nga na hihi, Topa nang taw hong om hi: numei te sungah thuphatoai na hihi, ci hi.
Ama in vantungmi a mu ciang, a sonthu hang in a thinsung buai a, bangbang paupuina hi tu ziam, ci ngaisun hi.
Taciang vantungmi in, Mary awng, lau heak in, banghangziam cile Pathian mai ah maipha nga zo ni hi, ci hi.
En in, nau na pai tu a, tapa nei tu ni hi, taciang a min Jesus phuak tu ni hi, ci hi.
Ama sia mi thupi hi tu a, A sangbel i Tapa, kici tu hi: taciang Topa Pathian in a Pa David i kumpi tokhum pia tu hi:
Ama in Jacob suan te a tawntung in uk tu a; Ama ukna sia tawp hun nei ngawl tu hi.
Mary in vantungmi kungah, bangbang piang thei tu ziam, keima in pa taw ki he ngei ngawl khi hi, ci hi.
Vantungmi in zo kik a, Tha Thiangtho na tungah hong theng tu a, A sangbel i vangletna in hong tuam tu hi: tua ahikom na sung pan in a suak tu tapa thiangtho sia Pathian Tapa kici tu hi, ci hi.
En in, na mealheak Elizbeth, a ciing ci in ngual i son ngei sia a kum ham zawkciang in tapa pai hi: tu in tha luk pha zo hi.
Banghangziam cile, Pathian taw a piang thei ngawl bangma om ngawl tu hi.

Mary in, keima sia Topa i sal nu ka hihi; ka tungah na ci bang in hi tahen, ci hi. Taciang vantungmi a kung pan in paikhia hi.   
\s1 Mary Eilizabeth Kung Haw
Tua hun in, Mary ding a, Judah ngam huam mualtung khua ah manlangtak in pai hi;
Taciang, Elizabeth in Mary paupuina a zak ciang in a ngil sungah nauno tawn hi; taciang Elizabeth sia Tha Thiangtho taw kidim a:
Aw ngingtak taw, nangma sia numei te sung pan thuphatoai na hihi, taciang na ngilsung a om nauno zong thuphatoai a hihi.
Bangbang in ka Topa i nu sia kei kungah hongpai ziam?
Banghangziam cile, en in, nong paupui na aw ka zak pociang, ka ngil sungah nauno sia lungdamna taw tawn hi.

A um nu sia thuphatoai a hihi: banghangziam cile tua thu te Topa in ama a son bang in vawt tu hi, ci hi.   
\s1 Mary in Pathian Pok
Mary in, ka nuntakna in Topa lamsang hi,
Keima hong Ngum Pathian tungah ka thaa a lungdam hi.
Banghangziam cile, nunniam kei a salnu hong ve hi: en vun, tu pan kipan in khangkhat zawk khangkhat, thuphatoai nu, hong kici tu hi.
Banghangziam cile a vanglian Pathian in keima atu in a thupi mama te vawt zo hi; taciang a min thiangtho hi.
A hesuakna sia ama a zakta te tungah khangkhat zawk khangkhat om tawntung hi.
Ama in a ban taw a thahatna hong lak zo a; a ki phasak te thinsung ngaisutna zong ki thethangsak siat zo hi.
Ama in a vanglian te amate tokhum pan in a nuai ah khiasuk zo a, mi nunniam te domto zo hi.
Ama in a ngilkial te thupha te taw ngilvasak zo a; a hau te khut hawm taw ki heamsak hi.
Ama in a hesuakna phawk tawntung in a sal Israel hu zo hi;
I pu i pa te kungah a sonsa bangma in, Abraham le a suan te hu hi, ci hi.

Taciang Mary sia Elizabeth kungah tha thum sung om a, ama inn ah ciakik hi.   
\s1 Tuiphumpa John Suak
Elizabeth nau sua tu hun a cin ciang in tapa nei hi.
Elizabeth kungah Topa hesuakna lianpi kilang ci a innpam te le a mealheak te in a zak uh ciang in lungdampui tek mama uh hi.
Nausen ni liat a cin ciang in vunteap tan tu in hongpai a, a pa min zui in, Zechariah, ci uh hi.
A nu in, hi ngawl hi; a min John kici tu hi, ci in zo hi.
Amate in, na phung sung uh ah hibang min nei kuama om ngawl hi, ci uh hi.
Taciang amate in a pa khut taw lak uh a, bangbang ci nuam ni ziam, ci dong uh hi.
Zechariah in lai at natu ngen a, a min sia John hi, ci at hi. Taciang a vekpi in lamdangsa mama uh hi.
Taciang thatkhatthu in a kam ki hong in a lei hong suakta kik ahikom, pau in Pathian pok hi.
A kim a om theampo tungah lau na hong theng a; tua thu sia Judah kual mualtung khuano theampo ah ki zel hi.

Tua thu a za theampo in amate thinsung tek ah keam uh a, hisia bangbang nausen hi peuma tu ziam! ci tek uh hi. Taciang Topa khut sia Ama tungah om hi.   
\s1 Zechariah in Maisang Thu Pualak
John i pa Zechariah sia Tha Thiangtho taw kidim hi, taciang maisang thu a pualak na ah,
Israel te Topa Pathian minthang tahen; banghangziam cile a mite ve in hun zo hi,
Eite atu in ngupna kii sia a sal David inn sung pan in hong suaksak zo hi;
Leitung kipat lai pan in kamsang thiangtho te kam zang in son zo hi:
I ngal te le hong ensan te khutsung pan in eite ngum tu in ahizong;
I pu i pa te tungah vawt tu in thu a ciam sa hesuakna le thuciam thiangtho phawk tawntung tu in ahizong;
Eite tungah pia tu le i ngal te khutsung pan in hong suaktasak tu a, lau na om ngawl in,
I nuntaksung theampo Ama mai ah thianthona le thutang suana taw Ama na i sep thei natu a hihi.
Taciang nang, nausen, A sangbel i kamsang, hong ci tu hi: banghangziam cile Topa mai ah a lampi puakhol tu in pai tu hi;
A mite tung ah, amate mawna pan in mawmaisak na tungtawn in ngupna thu hesak tu in,
I Pathian i a neam thuthiamna tungtawn in; van pan zing nisuak bang in hong ve zo hi,
Khuazing le thina lim sungah a to te khuavak pia tu le eite i peang te thinnopna lampi ah hong makai tu hi, ci hi.
Nausen sia khang a, thaa lam ah thahat hi, Israel te kungah a kilaak mateng duisung ah om hi.

\s1 Ngaknu Thiangtho Mary le Jesus  
\r Matt 1:18-25; Jn. 1:1,2,14
Tua hun laitak in Caesar Augustus in leitung bup misimna vawt tu in thupia hi.
Hi misimna masabel a vawt laitak in Syrenius sia Syria ngam uk a hihi.
Taciang mi theampo misimna nei tu in amate khua tek ah pai uh hi.
Joseph zong Galilee ngam, Nazareth khua pan in David khua, Judah ngam Bethlehem khua ah pai hi; banghangziam cile ama sia David i suan le minam a hihi:
Misimna nei tu in dokzu a piaksa Mary taw pai uh hi, Mary sia naungil lian mama zo hi.
Bethlehem ah a om uh laitak in, Mary a naunei tu ni hong cing hi.

A tacil tapa hong nei a, puan taw a tun zawkciang, khui ankuang sungah sial hi, banghangziam cile zintun inn ah amate atu inndoi om nawn ngawl hi.   
\s1 Vantungmi te le Tuucing te
Tua ngamsung ah tuucing te duisung ah ngiak uh a, zan in a tuuhon te cing in om uh hi.
Taciang, en vun, Topa vantungmi amate kungah hongpai a, Topa vangletna sia amate kiim teng ah taang hi: taciang amate lau mama uh hi.
Vantungmi in amate tung ah, lau heak vun: banghangziam cile, en vun, note tungah lungdamna thu hong puak khi hi, tua thu sia mi theampo atu in lungdamna lianpi hi tu hi.
Banghangziam cile tuni in David khuapi sungah Ngumpa Christ Topa suak zo hi.
Hisia in note atu musakna a hihi; nausen sia puan taw tun a, khui ankuang sungah a kisial na mu tu uh hi, ci hi.
Thakhatthu in vantungmi taw vantungmi honpi te Pathian pok uh a,
Van a sangbel na ah Pathian minthang tahen, leitung ah thinnop na om tahen a, mihing te tungah deisakna pha om tahen, ci hi.
Vantungmi te amate kung pan van ah a heakkik zawkciang in tuucing te in, tu in Bethlehem khua ah pai tawng, Topa i hong heaksak thu en tawng, khat le khat kici uh hi.
Taciang manlangtak in pai uh a, Mary, Joseph le khui ankuang sungah a kisial nausen mu uh hi.
Tuucing te in ama a mu uh ciang in, vantungmi in hi nausen thu taw kisai amate a son thu te midang te tungah son uh hi.
Tuucing te i son thu te a za theampo in lamdangsa mama uh hi.
Ahihang Mary in hi thu te theampo, a thinsung ah keam in ngaisun hi.

Vantungmi in amate tungah a son bang in, a zak uh le a mu uh thu te hang in tuucing te in Pathian vangletna le minthanna pok in heakkik uh hi.   
\s1 Jesus Vunteap Tan le Minphuak

Nausen sia vunteap tan tu ni liat a cin ciang, a min sia Jesus ci hi, tua min sia a nu in a ngilsung a pai ma in vantungmi i a phuakholsa min a hihi.   
\s1 Jesus Biakinn ah Paipui
Mary sia Moses thukham bang in thianthona hun a cin ciang in, Topa kungah ap tu in nausen sia Jerusalem ah paipui hi;
Topa thukham sungah, sulhong tapa masabel peuma Topa atu a thiangtho, kici tu hi; ci in ki at hi.

Topa thukham sungah a om bangma in, khutun kop khat, a hibale khutheh ni taw biakpiakna piak tu a hihi.   
\s1 Simeon in Jesus Toai
Taciang en vun, Jerusalem ah Simeon a kici pasal khat om hi; ama sia mi pha thutang le biakna sangah a ki pumpiak hi a, Israel te henepna a ngak khat zong a hihi: ama tungah Tha Thiangtho om hi.
Topa i Messiah na mu mateng na thi buatu hi, ci in Tha Thiangtho in pualak hi.
Tha ompui na taw in Simeon sia biakinn sungah hong pai a: thukham ngeina bang in vawtsak tu in nulepa te in nausen Jesus paipui uh hi,
Simeon in nausen a kang ah toai a, Pathian pok kawm in,
Topa awng, tu in, na thu bang in na sal keima thinnuamtak in hong paisak ta in:
Banghangziam cile na ngupna ka mit taw mu zo khi hi,
Tua thu sia mi theampo mai ah na vawtsa a hihi;
Gentile te tung khuavaksak tu le na minam Israel te minthan natu a hihi, ci hi.
Simeon pau nate sia Joseph le Mary te in lamdangsa mama uh hi.
Taciang Simeon in amate thupha pia a, a nu Mary kungah, hi nausen sia Israel mitampi te lutu na le mitampi te ki phokkik na hi tu hi; banghangziam cile kam ki nial na musakna hi tu hi;

Hi hi, namsau in na nuntakna hong sun tu hi, taciang mitampi te thinsung ngaisutna te kilangsak tu hi.   
\s1 Anna Kici Numei Kamsang
Asher suan, Phanuel tanu Anna a kici kamsang nu khat om a, ama sia huai mama zo hi: ama sia ngaknu thiangtho a hina pan in a pasal taw kum sali sung bek omkhawm hi;
Ama sia meingong hi a, kum sawm liat le kum li pha zo hi, biakinn pan pusuak ngawl in sun tawzan taw antang le thungen in Pathian naseam hi.

Jesus biakinn ah a thetpui laitak in Anna zong hong theng a, Topa tungah lungdam ko hi, taciang Jerusalem ah ngupna a ngakla te theampo tungah nausen thu son hi.   
\s1 Jesus Nazareth ah Ciapui  
\r Matt 2:19-23
Joseph le Mary te in Topa thukham bang in na theampo a vawt zawk uh ciang in, Galilee ngam Nazareth khua ah ciakik uh hi.

Nausen hong khang a, thaa lam ah thahat in, ciimna taw dim a: Pathian hesuakna ama tungah om hi.   
\s1 Nauno Jesus Doctor te taw Thu Kikum
Jesus i nulepa te kumsim paisanpoai ciang in Jerusalem ah pai bul uh hi.
Jesus kum sawm le kum ni a cin ciang in, Jerusalem ah ngeina bang in poai mun ah pai hi.
Poai man ciang in a inn ah ciakik uh hi, ahihang nauno Jesus sia Jerusalem ah tanglai hi; Joseph le a nu in tua thu a he bua uh hi.
Ahihang, mi honpi sungah hi tu hi, ci ngaisun uh a ni khat sung pai uh hi; taciang amate mealheak te le a ki naipui uh te sungah zong uh hi.
Amate in a mu ngawl uh ciang in, Jerusalem ah heakkik in zong uh hi.
Nithum zawkciang in amate in biakinn sungah mu hi, doctor te laizang ah to a, thu ngai le thu dong in om hi.
Amate in a mu uh ciang in lamdangsa mama uh a: a nu in, ka Tapa awng, banghang hibang in hong vawt ni ziam? en in, na pa taw thinngim mama in hong zong khu hi, ci hi.
Jesus in amate tung ah, \wj Banghang in hong zong nu ziam? ka Pa nasep seam hamtang tu khi hi, ci he ngawl nu ziam?\wj* ci hi.

Taciang amate in a sonnop na a tel bua uh hi.   
\s1 Jesus a Pilna Khang
Taciang amate taw pai a, Nazareth ah ciakik in amate thu ni in om hi: ahihang a nu in Ama kampau te a thinsung ah keamcing hi.
Jesus sia a ciimna le a pumpi khang a, Pathian mai le mihing te mai ah maipha nga hi.

\s1 Tuiphumpa John  
\r Matt 3:1-12; Mk 1:2-8; Jn. 1:19-28

Tiberius Caesar in ngam a uk zawk kum sawm le kum nga a cin ciang in, Pontius Pilate sia Judah ngam ukpa hi a, Herod sia Galilee ngam ukpa a hihi, taciang Herod nau Philip sia Ituraea le Trachonitis ngam ukpa a hihi, taciang Lysanias sia Abilene ngam ukpa a hihi,
Annas le Caiaphas te sia thiampi sangbel hi uh a, tua hun sung in duisung ah a om Zechariah tapa John tungah Pathian thu theng hi.
\x - \xo 3:3 \xt \x*Tua ahikom John sia Jordan ngun dung khuano te theampo ah maw ki sikkik na tuiphumna tungtawn in mawmaina thu hil hi.
Kamsangpa Isaiah i kammal te laibu sungah a ki atsa bang in, duisung ah a au aw khat in, Topa i lampi puakhol vun, lampi te na tangsak vun.
A kom na theampo dim vun a, mual sang le mualdung te theampo niamsak vun; a kingkoai theampo tangsak vun a, lampi ham theampo nealsak vun;
Taciang mi theampo in Pathian i ngupna mu tu uh hi, ci hi.
Ama kungah tui ki phum tu in hongpai mihonpi te kungah, maw, ngul suan te, hong theng tu thin-ukna pan suakta tu in kua in note kidopna hong pia ziam? ci hi.

Taciang mawna ki sikkikna taw a kiphu in nga pha te nga tavun, kote in ka pa uh Abraham nei khu hi: ci heak vun, banghangziam cile Pathian in hi suangtum te Abraham suan suaksak thei hi, hong ci khi hi.
Tu in thingkung te a bul ah heipui ki koi zo hi: nga pha a nga ngawl thingkung peuma phuk tu a, meisung ah khia hi.
Taciang mipi te in, tabang hithongle banglaw tu khu ziam? ci in dong uh hi.
Ama in, puansil ni a nei sia in a nei ngawl te pia tahen; an a nei sia in tabangma in vawt tahen, ci in zo hi.
Siadong te zong tui ki phum tu in hongpai uh a, Syapa awng, kote bangbang ngamta tu khu ziam? ci uh hi.
Taciang ama in, a kiciangtan za sang in a tamzaw khon heak vun, ci hi.

Ngalkap te in zong tabangma in, kote e, bangbang ngamta tu khu ziam? ci in dong uh hi. Amate kungah, zawthawk thu taw mite tungah bangma ngamta heak vun, a manngawl pi in mite mawsiat heak vun; na nga uh thaman taw lungkim vun, ci hi.
Mite in lametna a nei tek uh bangma in, John sia Christ a hi le hi ngawl, mi theampo in amate thinsung ah ngaisun tek uh hi.

Tua ahikom John in amate theampo tung ah, keima in a tatak in tui taw tuiphumna hong pia khi hi; ahihang kei sang in a vanglianzaw khat hongpai tu hi, a peangdap khau sutsak tu nangawn ka kilawm bua hi: Ama in Tha Thiangtho le mei taw baptisma hong pia tu hi:
A khut sungah tangkheaplaw toai a, tangzap tu hi, tang pha te beam sungah thun tu a; tangsi te a hi le a mit ngei ngawl meitaw hal tu hi, ci in zo kik hi.
Ama hanthotna sungah thudang tampi te zong mite tungah pualak hi.
Ahizong ngam uk Herod sia a naupa Philip i a zi, Herodias thu le a phangawl a vawt nate hang in John in tek hi,

Taciang Herod in John sia thongtaksak a, tabang in mawna dang vawt thua belap hi.   
\s1 John in Jesus Tuiphum  
\r Matt 3:13-17; Mk 1:9-11; Jn. 1:31-34
Ngual theampo tui a ki phum zawk uh ciang in, Jesus zong tui ki phum a, thu a nget laitak in van ki hong hi,

Tha Thiangtho sia vakhu bang in a tungah tuaksuk hi, taciang van pan in aw khat hong theng a, Nangma sia ka it mama Ka Tapa ni hi; na tungah ka lungkim mama hi, ci hi.   
\s1 Jesus Christ Khang Thu  
\r Matt 1:1-17
Tua hun in Jesus sia kum sawmthum hong cing hi, Ama sia mihing ngaisut na bang in Joseph tapa hi a, Joseph sia Heli tapa hi,
Heli sia Matthat tapa hi, Matthat sia Levi tapa hi, Levi sia Melchi tapa hi, Melchi sia Janna tapa hi, Janna sia Joseph tapa hi,
Joseph sia Mattathias tapa hi, Mattathias sia Amos tapa hi, Amos sia Nahum tapa hi, Nahum sia Esli tapa hi, Esli sia Nagge tapa hi,
Nagge sia Maath tapa hi, Maath sia Mattathias tapa hi, Mattathias sia Semei tapa hi, Semei sia Joseph tapa hi, Joseph sia Judah tapa hi,
Judah sia Joanan tapa hi, Joanan sia Rhesa tapa hi, Rhesa sia Zerubbabel tapa hi, Zerubbabel sia Shealtiel tapa hi, Shealtiel sia Neri tapa hi,
Neri sia Melchi tapa hi, Melchi sia Addi tapa hi, Addi sia Cosam tapa hi, Cosam sia Elmodam tapa hi, Elmodam sia Er tapa hi,
Er sia Jose tapa hi, Jose sia Eliezer tapa hi, Eliezer sia Jorim tapa hi, Jorim sia Matthat tapa hi, Matthat sia Levi tapa hi,
Levi sia Simeon tapa hi, Simeon sia Judah tapa hi, Judah sia Joseph tapa hi, Joseph sia Jonan tapa hi, Jonan sia Eliakim tapa hi,
Eliakim sia Melea tapa hi, Melea sia Menan tapa hi, Menan sia Mattatha tapa hi, Mattatha sia Nathan tapa hi, Nathan sia David tapa hi,
David sia Jesse tapa hi, Jesse sia Obed tapa hi, Obed sia Boaz tapa si. Boaz sia Salmon tapa hi, Salmon sia Nahshon tapa hi,
Nahshon sia Amminadab tapa hi, Amminadab sia Aram tapa hi, Aram sia Hezron tapa hi, Hezron sia Pharez tapa hi, Pharez sia Judah tapa hi,
Judah sia Jacob tapa hi, Jacob sia Isaac tapa hi, Isaac sia Abraham tapa hi, Abraham sia Terah tapa hi, Terah sia Nahor tapa hi,
Nahor sia Serug tapa hi, Serug sia Reu tapa hi, Reu sia Peleg tapa hi, Peleg sia Heber tapa hi, Heber sia Shelah tapa hi,
Shelah sia Cainan tapa hi, Cainan sia Arphaxad tapa hi, Arphaxad sia Shem tapa hi, Shem sia Noah tapa hi, Noah sia Lamek tapa hi,
Lamek sia Methuselah tapa hi, Methuselah sia Enok tapa hi, Enok sia Jared tapa hi, Jared sia Mahalalel tapa hi, Mahalalel sia Kenan tapa hi,
Kenan sia Enosh tapa hi, Enosh sia Seth tapa hi, Seth sia Adam tapa hi, Adam sia Pathian tapa a hihi.
Jesus sia Tha Thiangtho taw kidim in Jordan pan ciakik a, Thaa in duisung ah paipui hi,
Ni sawmli sung doaimangpa in ze-et hi. Tua hunsung theampo bangma ne ngawl hi: taciang tua ni te a bo zawkciang in a ngilkial hi.
Doaimangpa in ama tuung ah, Pathian Tapa na hile, hi suangtum te anluum suak tu in thupia in, ci hi.
Taciang Jesus in hibang in zo hi, \wj Mihing te sia anluum bek hi ngawl in, Pathian thu taw nungta zaw tu hi, ci ki at hi, \wj* ci hi.
Doaimangpa in mualsang dawn ah paipui a, leitung kumpingam theampo tawmvei sung in lak hi.
Taciang doaimangpa in, hi thuneina theampo le minthanna teng kong pia tu hi: banghangziam cile hite sia keima hong ki pia zo a; ka piaknop po pia khi hi.
